_comment: WTHIT state lines (compat/WthitStateLines, format in compat/StateLines): 'Label: n / max' from an integer block
state property. Every matching rule adds a line, in this order; a later rule whose label or property the block
already shows is skipped, so specific rules come first. 'blocks' take ids, '*' globs and '#block_tags'; 'except' skips ids/globs;
a block without the property skips the rule. 'label' is the line id and lang key creativecommon.wthit.state.<label>.
'mode': count = value / top (default), taken = what's left of a count of what's gone (cake bites),
plus_one = value + 1 of top + 1 (Brewin' gives a last slice at servings 0).
Copy this file to kubejs/assets/creativecommon/ to override. feature_writeup/wthit_lines.md 2.5.
